items.summary: The best ChatGPT that $100 can buy.
items.excerpt: # nanochat ![nanochat logo](dev/nanochat.png) ![scaling laws](dev/scaling_laws_jan26.png) nanochat is the simplest experimental harness for training LLMs. It is designed to run on a single GPU node, the code is minimal/hackable, and it covers all major LLM stages including tokenization, pretraining, finetuning, evaluation, and inference. For example, you can train your own GPT-2 capability LLM (which cost ~$43,000 to train in 2019) for only $48 (~2 hours of 8XH100 GPU node) and then talk to it over a simple CLI. On a spot instance, the total cost can be closer to ~$15. More generally, nanochat is configured out of the box to train an entire miniseries of compute-optimal models by setting one single complexity dial: `--depth`, the number of layers in the GPT transformer model (GPT-2 capability happens to be approximately depth 26). All other hyperparameters (the width of the transformer, number of heads, learning rate adjustments, training horizons, weight decays, ...) are calculated automatically in an optimal way. For questions about the repo, I recommend either using [DeepWiki](https://deepwiki.com/karpathy/nanochat) from Devin/Cognition to ask questions about the repo, or use the [Discussions tab](https://github.com/karpathy/nanochat/discussions), or come by the [#nanochat](https://discord.com/channels/1020383067459821711/1427295580895314031) channel on Discord. ## Time-to-GPT-2 Leaderboard Presently, the main focus of development is on tuning the pretraining stage, which…

items.title: "It's Fast, It's Cheap, It's Reliable" – Nick Ducoff from the Solana Foundation
items.summary: Samsung just put Solana stablecoin transfers into the wallet app on 82 million US Galaxy phones. Nick Ducoff says AI agents are picking Solana for the same reasons: "We're even starting to see AI use it. Agents are using Solana stablecoins more than any other blockchain, and I think they're choosing Solana for the same reason Samsung did. It's fast, it's cheap, it's reliable, it's decentralized, and there's on and off ramps into local fiat currencies all over the world." — Nick Ducoff, Head of Institutional Growth at the Solana Foundation, with Jennifer Sanasie on @CoinDesk's Public Keys at the @NYSEofficial

items.title: Show HN: ChainBounty – improving the blockchain funding model
items.summary: Abstract. Token-funded bounties to incentivize competition-style participation in blockchain development projects would result in wider and better allocation of investment, and allow investors to diversify exposure across a field of potentially successful projects. Overall this would increase the rate of progress within development of the blockchain space. We propose a centralised platform for the administration of token-funded bounty driven development projects whereby experts allocate pools of invested capital according to the technical merits of development projects, and investors are rewarded with token allocation in funded projects. Draft Whitepaper: http://chainbounty.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/07/chainbount... We see this as bringing a variation of the YC model to blockchain - experts select large numbers of small projects and provide them with funding to reach the next level of development. This is in contrast to heavily funded ICOs where tiny teams of developers are given hundreds of millions of dollars. After feedback from HN readers: - Do you think this model will better incentivize development in the blockchain space? - What particular challenges do you think would be useful to run? https://twitter.com/ChainBounty/ https://www.facebook.com/ChainBounty-449553402088106/
